the upload streams the pinned file hashed in flight (size and sha256 must match); replies are size-bounded; the returned CID must be the precomputed one; the gateway CAR must hold exactly the frozen file's DAG blocks, each hashed; only then can publish be prepared

pins checked before every send on two providers at one anchor: catalog/ledger/registry/reserve/executor code hashes, address book owner + entries, catalog owner/schema, ledger schema, admin with no code (no 7702), nonce = pending

publish refused if any enclave-site version exists; create refused if the owner's deployment counter moved (predicted id differs), the version differs, or minipc's payout wallet is not the admin: replan, never re-aim
each send is simulated fresh with its post-state; the labelled create+deposit+configure bundle pre-check must leave statusOf Ready and claimableBy true (simulation only)

journal written before a request reaches the browser; no duplicate publish/create; an unanswered request is released only with the nonce unused and the retry keeps that nonce; a landed hash is recovered by verification

landing: exact request (sender, recipient, chain, type, nonce, calldata, value, gas, fee caps, no authorization list), exact events (AppCreated/VersionPublished/VersionApprovalSet; MaxRateSet/Created/RunnerRateSet with the reviewed id), two confirmations, canonical, both providers agree

stage B starts only from a Created receipt verified on two providers with the reviewed id and only for the approved operations (sha256 104cfff8…); it is the reviewed queue, unchanged. Its readiness is process-local: every process (a restart included) re-verifies that binding before opening its own listener over the same journals; a submitted deposit/configure survives and is never re-prepared; a listener failure is retried from the page without re-signing

upload: the token, add and CAR requests refuse redirects (redirect: error); every failure leaves the upload module as fixed text (UploadRefusal); anything else, or any text quoting the signature, is withheld; request-body parse errors never quote the body
CAR: the whole header must equal the canonical DAG-CBOR {roots: [expected CID], version: 1}; varints minimal and at most 5 bytes; every block hashed; the block set exactly the frozen file's

wallet compatibility: landing requires the exact gas limit and fee caps no higher than requested (unchanged); a landed transaction with the request's sender/nonce/recipient/calldata/value but altered gas or fees halts the flow for review instead of waiting
